verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a dedicated 'Filters & Rules' help article, and a community comment notes that users have filters and rules worth migrating, so rule-based automatic actions on incoming mail exist. JMAP EventSource/WebPush push gives developers an event stream for building their own triggered automations, but only with custom code. Missing for 10: any documented detail on rule conditions and available actions, triggers beyond incoming mail (e.g. calendar or webhook events), native outbound webhooks or AI-driven rule creation, and hands-on corroboration of rule depth.
